thesis: The podcast argues that the American health crisis is fundamentally an environmental and incentive problem rather than a healthcare one, driven by a food system that systematically produces unhealthy people. This systemic failure began in the 1970s when shareholder pressure on big food companies led to a shift from real ingredients to ultra-processed, addictive, and toxin-laden alternatives, creating an environment where being healthy is structurally difficult.
